Setup token is HMAC-signed (server secret), 15-minute TTL, single-purpose (only /setup + /verify accept it).
Setup token cannot reset an already-enrolled account - /setup rejects it when MFA is already active. Disable via a real session first.
Re-enrollment via /setup is allowed during the pending state (before /verify), so a user who mistyped their authenticator can restart enrollment.
CSRF is enforced for cookie-session callers; Bearer and setup-token callers each carry their own integrity proof and skip it.
